script_text:
Stop! Taurus, the stars are screaming at you right now.

Venus, your ruling planet, is now squaring disruptive Pluto in your 10th House of Public Image, forcing hidden power games at work into the light. This pressure will test your patience in public roles and demand you stay honest in meetings, avoiding impulsive control battles.

If you're single, the Venus‑Pluto tension draws irresistibly intense partners who see right through you; if you're partnered, hidden jealousy may surface, so practice vulnerable honesty.

Your 2nd House of Values benefits as Mercury forms a beneficial sextile to Jupiter, turning clever conversations into unexpected monetary gain, provided you stay reliable. Mercury’s precise sextile amplifies calculations, turning short talks into big contracts.

Avoid making rushed decisions under this charged energy, or you may lose the trust you've built.

Follow for tomorrow's reading so you stay ahead of the cosmic currents.
